craft_notes: Sthāyin: ultimate self-showing. Rows: claim then body. Read aloud: proclamation.

lines: Here the last cause-work is just this: the free Lord's self,
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatra pāramārthika etāvān kāryakāraṇabhāvo yad uta kartṛsvabhāvasya svatantrasya bhagavata evaṃvidhena śivādidharāntena vapuṣā svarūpabhinnena svarūpaviśrāntena ca prathanam
